topic: What if mosquitoes vanished? Fewer diseases like malaria, but some fish and birds that eat them would lose food.

episode.title: What If Mosquitoes Vanished?

shots.scene: Colourful 3D science lab, vertical frame, glowing mosquito hologram between Nova and Byte, no text.
shots.action: Nova swipes the mosquito hologram into sparkling empty space.

shots.narration: Without mosquito bites, mosquito-borne diseases would spread far less.
shots.scene: Vertical lab view with a holographic globe surrounded by mosquito silhouettes and red disease particles, no text.
shots.action: Nova dims the mosquito silhouettes and their connected disease particles.
shots.mood: Hopeful green glow, clean colourful surfaces.

shots.narration: [excited] That includes malaria, carried by infected mosquitoes.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a magnified hologram of a mosquito containing glowing malaria parasites, no text.
shots.action: Nova highlights the parasites inside the holographic mosquito.

shots.narration: But mosquitoes also belong to food webs.
shots.scene: Vertical lab frame with a holographic pond, mosquito larvae, adult mosquitoes, fish and birds connected by glowing lines, no text.
shots.action: Nova expands the pond hologram above the lab table.
shots.mood: Lush greens and blues, thoughtful discovery.

shots.narration: Some fish eat mosquito larvae living in water.
shots.scene: Lab beside a large underwater pond hologram, tiny mosquito larvae near the surface and a small fish below, no text.
shots.action: A holographic fish snaps up a mosquito larva.

shots.narration: [surprised] Some birds eat adult mosquitoes, so they'd lose food.
shots.scene: Colourful lab with a pond hologram showing a bird above reeds and glowing mosquito silhouettes, no text.
shots.action: Nova fades the mosquito silhouettes from the bird's feeding area.
shots.mood: Soft amber light, thoughtful concern without danger.

shots.narration: Scientists think many predators could switch to other prey.
shots.scene: Vertical lab view of a holographic pond with fish, birds and several other small insects, no text.
shots.action: Nova illuminates alternative feeding connections in the hologram.

shots.narration: Their larvae also help recycle nutrients in water.
shots.scene: Lab with a magnified pond hologram showing mosquito larvae beside floating organic particles, no text.
shots.action: A holographic larva filters tiny organic particles from the water.

shots.narration: [surprised] Some mosquitoes pollinate flowers—what if bees vanished next?
shots.scene: Colourful lab, vertical close-up of a flower hologram with a mosquito touching pollen and a separate glowing bee model, no text.
shots.action: Nova enlarges the bee model beside the flower.
shots.mood: Sunny yellow and purple glow, delighted anticipation.

episode.endHook: Some mosquitoes pollinate flowers—what if bees vanished next?
episode.description: Dr. Nova shows Byte a world without mosquitoes: fewer diseases, but missing meals for some fish and birds. Explore the surprising roles these tiny insects play in nature.
